$comment: How the phone reaches each screen the desktop inventory reads (mobile/flows/expected), as Maestro steps.
mobile/scripts/flows-from-inventory.mjs puts these in front of each screen's checks in mobile/flows/data.
Placeholders: {{state}} is the inventory's state ('PL3002/modules/modul-4'), {{1}} {{2}} {{3}} its parts split at '/',
{{list}} the Tugas & Ujian list a Task or exam was opened from (todo, done), {{appId}}, and a value that is exactly
{{exam}} the phone's id for the exam a state names (DK4073-UTS from 'DK4073-UTS:six:2179909', PL3032-UAS from an unkeyed row's title), {{examKind}} its UTS or UAS.
{{taskId}} the Task a state names (117003, or 117764 from a take-home's 'DK4073-UTS:task:117764').
{{demoLink}} is the link that opens the demo build in the scenario (its EDUNEX_DEMO settings as the query).
'steps' run for every state; 'byState' maps a pattern on the state to the steps that run instead.
'byEntry' maps a pattern on '<entry id>|<entry context>' (its day) to steps run before that entry's checks: Jadwal shows one day at a time.
'relaunch': true starts the app afresh before each state (a clean way back from a detail screen).
Status 'placeholder': steps written from the testID convention (PROGRESS.md Decision 8) before the screen exists;
the lead replaces them with the real steps and sets status to 'ready' as each screen lands.

'scrollTimeout': how long each item's scroll may take on a long screen (default 4000 ms). 'phoneSkips' (top level): the desktop's items the phone leaves out on purpose, by entry id pattern, with the scope row and why: no checks, not counted.
The shared launch is tried twice: over a course's sixty fresh starts, one now and then stuck on its splash.

After the first sync, a scenario with a row the app doesn't know (odd) asks once about problem reports over the bottom of the screen: the shared launch answers 'Jangan kirim', so it neither covers the taps nor asks again.

presence: Kuliah shows each course as a slim row (round 2); a course's bar, count, next class and exception are on its page, so those entries open it (byEntry), and every other entry comes back to Kuliah first. The page's attendance card is there only when it has something to say (none without SIX): the page is waited for, the card a moment more.
The demo signs in and reads after the first frame (mobile/src/host/settling.ts): the launch waits for the top bar's status.settling to go before any check.

schedule (v4): one day at a time under the week strip; next week is a swipe across the strip. A class block shows its short name and room only, so the week's class entries open the class's sheet (Beranda's, sheet.nowClass; a meeting only Edunex announced opens Jadwal's own, sheet.class, as with no SIX) where its code, times and full name are, and every other entry closes it first.

class (v4): a class's sheet is Beranda's (sheet.nowClass), or Jadwal's own (sheet.class) for a meeting only Edunex announced (edunex-only); who teaches it and where its attendance counts are on its course page, so those entries go there with Buka mata kuliah, and the entries after come back to the sheet. A check scrolling up can drag the sheet closed: then the class is tapped again before Buka mata kuliah.

home (v4): Proposal Tugas Akhir's class is a Friday class on Jadwal; it opens Beranda's sheet with SIX (sheet.nowClass) and Jadwal's own without (sheet.class), so its route waits for either, and every home entry first closes either sheet before going back to Beranda.

home (v4): a tap while Beranda is still sliding after a scroll only stops it (Android), so the now card's routes scroll to the greeting, let the page settle, and tap the card once more if its sheet didn't come.

welcome.$comment: Round 2 (W15): the welcome is one screen; 'connected' is who's signed in, on Settings once SIX joined; 'ready' is Beranda's summary card once the first read is in.

home.$comment: Round 2, v4: the now card's facts in its sheet; today's other classes in their row's sheet (tomorrow's meeting on Jadwal); the items to handle, the date and term and what changed on Perlu kamu urus's screen; the old course cards' facts on each course's page.

phoneSkips.why: the SKS bar's legend on Rencana (this semester's and the planned SKS): the judge's round 2 (15, 7.5/10) kept Rencana's card to its two figures and its chip, so the bar moved to Kurikulum's card, and the judge's round 3 (16, 7.5/10) kept that card to its figure and its bar, so the legend went (the bar's spoken value says the share; Kurikulum's Pilihan row says what's passed, this semester and planned)

the 'Sisa' line under 'Sisa saja' (required and electives left): the judge's round 3 (16, 7.5/10) found it repeats the numbers above it, so 'Sisa saja' is the switch alone, and the Wajib tersisa and Pilihan rows right over it say the same ('2 mata kuliah · 6 SKS', '27 dari 27 SKS')

Beranda's 'Semua siap' card's counts (courses · Tasks · meetings): the judge's round 1 (34, 7/10) asked for one short line with its one action, so the card says 'Semua siap, Dimas.' and opens the summary, whose Lihat semua says what was read
the desktop's phone link (ntfy) code: the phone is the phone, it has no link to another (PROGRESS.md A18)
the phone link's quiet hours (Jam tenang), part of the same desktop-only section (A18)

the out-of-reach group's heading with its count ('Tak bisa lagi capai 80% 1'): Kuliah's rows no longer spend a heading per group, and the same fact leads the screen as the big number, '1' beside 'mata kuliah tak bisa lagi capai 80%' (card.kuliahNumber), each such course's row carrying its 'Lewat batas' chip
Perlu kamu urus's advice to check with the lecturer: Arqila's rules cut explanatory sentences from tab screens; the row keeps the course, its best case against the target and one status
a take-home exam's hand-in day: on Perlu kamu urus the row keeps one meta line, and the day is on the exam's own page (checked there as exam-detail)

the exam's day in full under its name: the judge's round 2 (06) asked for one date card, so the page says the day once, on that card ("Kam 15 Okt", checked in the same exam-detail's Kapan dan di mana)
